title: Forward kinematics of a two-link planar arm
instructions:
## Where is the hand?

A planar arm has two links of length 1 m. Joint angles are θ₁ (shoulder, from the x axis) and θ₂ (elbow, relative to link 1). The end-effector is at x = cos θ₁ + cos(θ₁ + θ₂), y = sin θ₁ + sin(θ₁ + θ₂).

1. Write x as an expression in a = θ₁ and b = θ₂ (radians).
2. x and 3. y when θ₁ = 90° and θ₂ = −90°.
4. x when θ₁ = θ₂ = 0.
5. The maximum reach of the arm.
6. For the hand at (1, 1), the size of the elbow angle |θ₂| in degrees.
hints: Fully stretched, both cosines are 1: reach = 2.
Distance to (1, 1) is √2; the cosine rule gives cos θ₂ = (2 − 1 − 1)/(2·1·1) = 0, so θ₂ = ±90°.
